units.source_text: 他邀苗子去参观时代节的时候，对游行队伍的背景—御所那片宽阔的苍翠松林，比对穿上各种时代服装的游行队伍要感兴趣得多。

en.t: When he invited Naeko to see the Festival of the Ages, he was far more interested in the procession's backdrop, the broad green pine grove of the Imperial Palace, than in the procession itself with people dressed in costumes from various eras.

units.source_text: 也许是从日常的生活中解放出来的缘故吧。

en.t: Perhaps it was because he had been set free from everyday life.

units.source_text: 然而，这一点苗子体会不到，因为她是在山沟沟里，即是在狭窄的山谷里干活……

en.t: However, Naeko could not understand this, because she worked deep in the mountains, that is, in a narrow valley...
